title: Thai government standard form: construction contract (English version)
provenance: Standard form for Thai government agencies, issued under the public procurement rules. The English version was translated from the Thai original with GPT and supplied by the app's author. File: 1_3_Construction_Contract_English.docx.
rights_note: Official form published under public procurement rules. The Thai Copyright Act, section 7, treats regulations, notifications and orders of government agencies as outside copyright, so reuse should be possible. Verify, and take the Thai original from the official source.

party_labels.Employer: the Owner (a Thai government agency in the original)

version_note: Appears to be the form before the revision announced for 22 September 2026: it lacks the serious-danger termination ground. Check against the current official form.
differences_from_target: Written for a government agency as Employer, so it favours the Employer heavily: the Employer's rulings are final, the Contractor bears most risks and cannot claim extra time or money in many cases.
Contains public-procurement items that do not apply to a private contract: Thai vessels (Clause 22), skilled labour standards (Clause 23), direct payment from the Treasury.
Has both unit-price and lump-sum versions of the payment and time clauses.
Useful for clauses the app's template lacks: performance security, advance payment, retention, defects liability, variations, recovery of damages, site clean-up.

quality_notes: Written for a government agency as the Employer. Numbers in brackets point to the notes entry.

clauses.title: Scope of work
quality_notes: Contractor supplies labour, materials, tools and equipment, as in the app's template.
clauses.text:
The Employer agrees to employ and the Contractor agrees to undertake the work of [...] (7),
at [...]
Sub-district/Khwaeng [...] District/Khet [...]
Province [...], in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Contract
and the documents attached hereto. The Contractor shall provide suitable labour, materials, tools,

clauses.title: Contract documents
quality_notes: Conflicts between annexes are resolved by the Employer's final ruling with no extra payment; the EPC subcontract has the same rule.
clauses.text:
The following documents attached hereto shall form an integral part of this Contract:
2.1 Appendix 1 – Drawings [...] Number of pages [...]
2.2 Appendix 2 – Specifications/Details [...] Number of pages [...]
2.3 Appendix 3 – Bill of Quantities and Prices [...] Number of pages [...]
2.4 Appendix 4 – Quotation [...] Number of pages [...]
[...] etc. [...]
If any provision contained in an attachment conflicts or is inconsistent with this Contract, the provisions
of this Contract shall prevail. If the attachments conflict with one another, the Contractor shall comply
with the Employer’s determination. The Employer’s determination shall be final, and the Contractor
shall have no right to claim any additional payment, damages or expenses from the Employer.

clauses.title: Performance security
quality_notes: Types of security are listed in note (8). The security must stay valid until the Contractor is released, be topped up if it falls in value, and is returned without interest.
The app's template has no performance security clause.
clauses.text:
At the time of execution of this Contract, the Contractor has provided a performance security in the
form of [...] (8), in the amount of Baht [...]
([...]), equivalent to [...] percent (9)
([...]) of the Contract Price, to the Employer as security for the due performance of this Contract.
(10) Where the Contractor provides a bank guarantee as the performance security, such bank guarantee
shall be issued by a bank carrying on business in Thailand, or by a finance company or securities finance
company duly authorised to conduct finance and guarantee business in accordance with the notifications
of the Bank of Thailand and in accordance with the form prescribed by the competent government procurement authority.
An electronic bank guarantee may be provided in accordance with the procedures prescribed by the Comptroller General’s Department.
The guarantee shall remain valid until the Contractor has been released from all obligations under this Contract.
The performance security shall remain sufficient to cover all liabilities of the Contractor throughout the Contract period.
If the security is reduced, becomes impaired, or ceases to cover the Contractor’s liabilities for any reason, including
where delay in completion causes the completion date or the expiry date of the Contractor’s defects liability to change,
the Contractor shall provide a replacement or additional security sufficient to restore the required amount within [...]
([...]) days from the date of receipt of written notice from the Employer.
The performance security provided under this Clause shall be returned to the Contractor without interest when the
Contractor has been released from all obligations and liabilities under this Contract.

clauses.title: Contract price and payment: unit-price contract
quality_notes: Payment is by measured quantity; unit prices fall to 90% beyond 125% and 83% beyond 150% of the estimate, and an overhead allowance applies below 75%.
Probably not suitable for a lump-sum rooftop solar contract.
clauses.text:
The Employer agrees to pay and the Contractor agrees to accept the Contract Price of Baht [...]
([...]), inclusive of Value Added Tax in the amount of Baht [...]
([...]), together with all other taxes and expenses.
The unit prices specified in the Bill of Quantities and Prices attached as Appendix 3 shall apply.
The Parties acknowledge that the quantities stated in the construction schedule or Bill of Quantities and Prices
are estimates only. The actual quantities may be greater or less than the estimated quantities, and the Employer
shall pay the Contractor according to the applicable unit price for the quantities actually completed.
Neither Party shall alter the unit prices or claim compensation merely because the actual quantity differs from
the quantity specified in the Contract, except as follows:
4.1 Where the actual quantity completed exceeds 125% but does not exceed 150% of the quantity specified in the
Contract or Bill of Quantities and Prices, payment shall be made at 90% of the contractual unit price.
4.2 Where the actual quantity completed exceeds 150% of the quantity specified in the Contract or Bill of Quantities
and Prices, payment shall be made at 83% of the contractual unit price.
4.3 Where the actual quantity completed is less than 75% of the quantity specified in the Contract or Bill of Quantities
and Prices, payment shall be made at the contractual unit price and an additional compensation for Overhead and
Mobilization shall be paid at 17% of the difference between the estimated total quantity of the relevant item and
the actual quantity completed, multiplied by the contractual unit price. Such additional compensation shall be paid
in the final payment.
4.4 Any additional payment under Clauses 4.1 or 4.2 shall be made in the final payment or, at the Employer’s discretion,
before the final payment, except where the Employer considers that the actual quantity is unrelated to the remaining
Works and that the remaining Works do not affect payment for the completed Works. The Employer may make such
additional payment together with the relevant progress payment. The determination whether an item falls within
these provisions shall be at the Employer’s sole discretion.
The Employer shall make monthly payments according to the actual progress of the Works. After the Employer or its
officer has inspected the completed Works and found them satisfactory and compliant with this Contract, the Employer
shall issue a certificate of acceptance to the Contractor. The final payment shall be made only after all Works have
been fully completed, including cleaning and restoring the construction site as required under Clause 20.
Where applicable, payment shall be transferred to the Contractor’s bank account specified below, and the Contractor
shall bear all bank transfer fees and other charges imposed by the bank.

clauses.title: Contract price and payment: lump-sum contract
quality_notes: Price includes VAT, unlike the app's template (price excluding VAT).
The last instalment depends on completion and on cleaning the site (Clause 20).
clauses.text:
The Employer agrees to pay and the Contractor agrees to accept the lump-sum Contract Price of Baht [...]
([...]), inclusive of Value Added Tax in the amount of Baht [...]
([...]), together with all other taxes and expenses. Payment shall be made by instalments as follows:
Instalment 1: Baht [...] ([...]), upon completion of [...]
within [...]
Instalment 2: Baht [...] ([...]), upon completion of [...]
within [...]
[...] etc. [...]
Final Instalment: Baht [...] ([...]), upon full and proper completion of all Works
under this Contract, including cleaning and restoring the construction site as required under Clause 20.
Payment shall be transferred to the Contractor’s bank account specified in the Contract. The Contractor shall bear
any transfer fees, bank charges and other expenses imposed in connection with such transfer.

clauses.title: Advance payment
quality_notes: Advance against a guarantee, recovered by deductions from each payment; repayable within 7 days if the contract is terminated.
The app's template has no advance payment clause.
clauses.text:
The Employer agrees to pay the Contractor an advance payment of Baht [...] ([...]),
equivalent to [...] percent ([...]) of the Contract Price specified in Clause 4.
The advance payment shall be made after the Contractor has provided security for the advance payment in the form
of a domestic bank guarantee, electronic bank guarantee or Thai government bond, as applicable, in the full amount
of the advance payment.
The Contractor shall issue a receipt for the advance payment in the form prescribed by the Employer and shall comply
with the following conditions concerning the use and repayment of the advance payment:
5.1 The Contractor shall use the advance payment solely for expenses incurred in performing the Works. If the Contractor
uses all or any part of the advance payment for any other purpose, the Employer may immediately demand repayment
or enforce the advance payment security.
5.2 Upon the Employer’s request, the Contractor shall provide evidence of expenditure of the advance payment within
15 days from receipt of written notice. If the Contractor fails to provide such evidence within that period, the Employer
may immediately demand repayment or enforce the advance payment security.
5.3(A) For a unit-price Contract, the Employer shall deduct [...] percent ([...]) from each monthly payment
until the advance payment has been fully recovered, except that the entire outstanding balance may be deducted from
the final monthly payment.
5.3(B) For a lump-sum Contract, the Employer shall deduct [...] percent ([...]) from each instalment until the
advance payment has been fully recovered, except that the entire outstanding balance may be deducted from the final instalment.
5.4 Any amount payable by the Contractor to the Employer in settlement of a debt or liability under this Contract shall
be deducted from amounts otherwise payable to the Contractor before any deduction for recovery of the advance payment.
5.5 Upon termination of this Contract, if the outstanding advance payment exceeds the amount otherwise payable to the
Contractor after other deductions, the Contractor shall repay the outstanding amount within 7 days from receipt of written notice.
5.6 The advance payment security shall be returned in accordance with the extent to which the advance payment has been
recovered, subject to the applicable requirements for replacement or reduction of the security.

clauses.title: Retention
quality_notes: Percentage deducted from each payment; the Contractor may swap the retention for a bank guarantee; returned without interest with the final payment.
The EPC subcontract retains 5% for one year after handover.
clauses.text:
From each payment due to the Contractor, the Employer shall retain [...] percent ([...]) as retention.
When the retained amount reaches not less than Baht [...] ([...]), the Contractor may request
release of the retention by providing a bank guarantee or electronic bank guarantee issued by a domestic bank as security
in substitution for the retained amount. The Employer shall return the retention and/or substitute bank guarantee without
interest together with the final payment, subject to the terms of this Contract.

clauses.title: Time for completion and Employer's right to terminate (durations)
quality_notes: Termination triggers include late or doubtful completion, any breach, absolute receivership or bankruptcy, and ignoring the inspection committee's instructions. Termination does not affect damages.
Does not contain the serious-danger termination ground that a September 2026 revision reportedly added, so this may be the earlier form.
clauses.text:
Within [...] ([...]) days from the date following execution of this Contract, the Contractor shall submit a work programme
satisfactory to the Employer, showing the sequence of Works and the time required for the principal activities.
The Contractor shall commence the Works within [...] ([...]) days from the date following receipt of the notice to proceed
and shall complete the Works within [...] ([...]) days thereafter.
If the Contractor fails to submit the work programme, fails to commence the Works within the prescribed period, fails or is
unable to complete the Works within the prescribed period, or there is reason to believe that completion will be delayed,
or if the Contractor breaches any provision of this Contract, becomes subject to an absolute receivership order or bankruptcy,
or fails to comply with an instruction of the inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant duly appointed by the Employer,
the Employer shall have the right to terminate this Contract and to engage another contractor to complete the Works.
Termination shall not prejudice the Employer’s right to claim damages from the Contractor. The Employer’s failure to exercise
the right of termination shall not release the Contractor from its liabilities under this Contract.

clauses.title: Time for completion and Employer's right to terminate (fixed dates)
quality_notes: Same termination triggers as 7(A), with fixed start and completion dates.
clauses.text:
The Contractor shall commence the Works on [...] day of [...] B.E. [...] and shall complete the Works in full
by [...] day of [...] B.E. [...] . If the Contractor fails to commence or complete the Works within the prescribed
period, or if there is reason to believe that completion will be delayed, or if the Contractor breaches any provision of this Contract,
becomes subject to an absolute receivership order or bankruptcy, or fails to comply with an instruction of the inspection committee,
supervising officer or consultant duly appointed by the Employer, the Employer shall have the right to terminate this Contract and
engage another contractor to complete the Works. Termination shall not prejudice the Employer’s right to claim damages.
The Employer’s failure to exercise the right of termination shall not release the Contractor from its liabilities under this Contract.

clauses.title: Liability for defects
quality_notes: Rectification at the Contractor's cost; the Employer may rectify at the Contractor's cost if the Contractor does not act, and may act at once in urgent cases.
Note (20): the defects liability period should normally be at least two years from acceptance.
The app's template has no defects clause.
clauses.text:
After the Works have been fully completed and accepted by the Employer from the Contractor or a replacement contractor,
if any defect or damage arising from the Works occurs within [...] ([...]) years and [...] ([...]) months from the date
of acceptance, and such defect or damage is attributable to the Contractor’s use of improper materials, defective workmanship
or failure to comply with recognised engineering or technical standards, the Contractor shall promptly rectify the defect
without delay and at its own cost.
If the Contractor fails to commence such rectification within [...] ([...]) days from receipt of written notice from the Employer,
or fails to complete the rectification within the period specified by the Employer, the Employer may carry out the rectification
itself or engage another person to do so, at the Contractor’s cost.
In an urgent case where prompt rectification is necessary and the Employer cannot wait for the Contractor to act within the period
specified above, the Employer may carry out or procure the rectification itself, at the Contractor’s cost.
Any action taken by the Employer or another person shall not release the Contractor from its liability. If the Contractor fails to
reimburse the costs or damages demanded by the Employer, the Employer may enforce the performance security.

clauses.title: Subcontracting
quality_notes: Written approval needed; approval does not release the Contractor; penalty for unauthorised subcontracting (note (21): at least 10% of the subcontracted value).
The app's template only restricts transfer of the Contractor's rights and obligations.
clauses.text:
The Contractor shall not subcontract all or any part of the Works without the Employer’s prior written approval, except to the extent
expressly permitted in writing by the Employer. Any approval shall not release the Contractor from any liability or obligation under
this Contract, and the Contractor shall remain fully liable for the acts, omissions and negligence of its subcontractors and their agents
or employees.
If the Contractor subcontracts any part of the Works in breach of this Clause, the Contractor shall pay a penalty to the Employer
at the rate of [...] percent ([...]) of the value of the subcontracted Works, without prejudice to the Employer’s right to terminate.

clauses.title: Contractor's supervision
quality_notes: A full-time representative with written authority; the Employer approves and may demand replacement at no cost and with no extension of time.
clauses.text:
The Contractor shall supervise the Works diligently, efficiently and competently. During performance of the Works, the Contractor
shall appoint a full-time representative responsible for supervising the Works. Such representative shall be duly authorised by the Contractor.
Any instruction or advice given by the Employer, the inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant appointed by the Employer
to such representative shall be deemed to have been given to the Contractor.
The appointment shall be made in writing and shall be subject to the Employer’s prior written approval. The Contractor shall not replace
or appoint a new representative without the Employer’s prior written approval.
The Employer may require the Contractor to replace the representative by written notice. The Contractor shall promptly make the replacement
without any additional payment or extension of time.

clauses.title: Contractor's liability
quality_notes: The Contractor repairs damage to the Works even if caused by force majeure until final acceptance, and defends and reimburses the Employer for third-party claims. Strongly one-sided.
The app's template has no third-party liability or indemnity clause.
clauses.text:
The Contractor shall be liable for any accident, damage or danger arising from the Contractor’s performance of the Works and for any
damage caused by its employees, agents or subcontractors, if any.
The Contractor shall be responsible for any damage to the Works, even where such damage results from Force Majeure, and shall repair
or replace the damaged Works at its own cost, except to the extent caused by the Employer’s fault.
This liability shall cease upon the Employer’s final acceptance of the Works, except for liability for defects or damage under Clause 8.
The Contractor shall also be liable to third parties for any damage arising from the acts or omissions of the Contractor, its employees,
agents or subcontractors. If the Employer is demanded, sued or required to pay damages to a third party, the Contractor shall, at its own
cost, take all necessary steps to defend and hold the Employer harmless and shall immediately reimburse the Employer for such damages
and all related costs and expenses.

clauses.title: Payment of employees
quality_notes: The Employer may pay unpaid wages from contract money; the Contractor must insure all workers and hand over the policies on request.
clauses.text:
The Contractor shall pay its employees at the rates and within the periods agreed with such employees.
If the Contractor fails to pay wages or other compensation due to its employees, the Employer may use amounts otherwise payable to
the Contractor to make such payments, and such payment shall be deemed payment to the Contractor under this Contract.
The Contractor shall procure insurance for all employees engaged in the Works, covering all liabilities of the Contractor, including
subcontractors, for compensable injury or death arising from any accident or danger to employees or other persons engaged by the Contractor
or its subcontractors. The Contractor shall provide the relevant insurance policies and evidence of premium payment upon the Employer’s request.

clauses.title: Inspection of the Works
clauses.text:
Where the Employer appoints an inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant to supervise the Contractor’s performance,
such persons shall have the right to enter factories and construction sites at any time to inspect the Works. The Contractor shall provide
reasonable facilities and assistance for such inspection.
The appointment of an inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant shall not relieve the Contractor from any responsibility or liability under this Contract.

clauses.title: Errors or discrepancies in drawings and specifications
quality_notes: The Employer's ruling is final and the Contractor cannot claim extra money or time.
clauses.text:
The Contractor warrants that it has thoroughly inspected and understood the drawings and specifications. If any drawing or specification
is erroneous or inconsistent with engineering or technical principles, the Contractor agrees to comply with the determination of the Employer,
inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant appointed by the Employer so as to complete the Works.
Such determination shall be final. The Contractor shall not claim any additional payment, damages or expenses, or request an extension of time,
as a result thereof.

clauses.title: Employer's supervision
quality_notes: The Employer's supervisors may order corrections, changes, additions and omissions and may stop work temporarily; no extension of time or damages for the delay.
clauses.text:
The inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant appointed by the Employer shall have authority to inspect and supervise the Works
to ensure compliance with this Contract and may order the Contractor to correct, vary, add to or omit any part of the Works.
If the Contractor refuses or fails to comply, the Employer, inspection committee, supervising officer or consultant may order the relevant Works
to be suspended temporarily. Any resulting delay shall not entitle the Contractor to an extension of time or compensation.

clauses.title: Variations and rectification
quality_notes: Employer may order extra work in writing within the general scope; contract rates apply, otherwise agreed or set by the Employer, and the Contractor must proceed meanwhile.
The app's template only has a short price-adjustment item for changes (3.5).
clauses.text:
The Employer may by written instruction require the Contractor to perform special work not shown or included in the Contract Documents,
provided that such work falls within the general scope and purpose of this Contract. The Employer may also instruct changes or amendments
to the drawings and specifications.
The rates or prices specified in this Contract shall apply to all additional, varied or omitted Works. Where no applicable rate or price is
specified, the Employer and Contractor shall agree a new rate or price and any corresponding extension of time, if applicable.
If the Parties cannot agree, the Employer shall determine a reasonable and proper rate or price, and the Contractor shall proceed with the
instruction pending such determination in order to avoid damage to the Works.

clauses.title: Penalty
quality_notes: Daily amount in baht, plus daily supervision costs; further damages are allowed above the penalty. There is no cap in the form.
Note (22): the daily rate is 0.01% to 0.10% of the value of the works; the app's template uses 0.05% per day capped at 5%.
The translation calls this a 'penalty'; the app's template calls its clause 'liquidated damages'. Whether the two are interchangeable under Thai law should be checked against a Thai-law source.
clauses.text:
If the Contractor fails to complete the Works within the time specified in this Contract and the Employer has not terminated the Contract,
the Contractor shall pay a daily penalty of Baht [...] ([...]) and, where applicable, daily supervision costs
of Baht [...] ([...]) where the Employer is required to engage an additional supervising officer.
The penalty and supervision costs shall accrue from the day following the contractual completion date or any extended completion date until
the date on which the Works are actually completed.
The Contractor shall also be liable for any additional damages arising from delay to the extent such damages exceed the penalty and supervision costs.
If, before termination, the Employer considers that the Contractor will be unable to continue performing the Contract, the Employer may terminate
the Contract and exercise the rights under Clause 18. Where the Employer has demanded payment of the penalty after the completion date,
the Employer may continue to impose the penalty until the date of termination.

clauses.title: Employer's rights following termination
quality_notes: Employer may complete the work itself, use the Contractor's equipment and materials, forfeit the performance security and recover extra costs and supervision costs.
clauses.text:
Upon termination, the Employer may complete the Works itself or engage another person to complete them. The Employer or such person may use
construction equipment, temporary works, structures and materials which, in the Employer’s reasonable opinion, should be retained for completion
of the Works.
The Employer may forfeit or enforce all or part of the performance security as it considers appropriate. The Contractor shall be liable for any
damages exceeding the performance security, including additional costs of completing the Works and additional supervision costs, which the Employer
may deduct from retention or any amount otherwise payable to the Contractor.

clauses.title: Recovery of penalties, damages and costs
quality_notes: Payment within a stated number of days after notice, then set-off against payments, retention or the performance security; the Contractor pays any shortfall.
clauses.text:
If the Contractor fails to comply with any provision of this Contract for any reason, resulting in penalties, damages or costs incurred by the Employer,
the Contractor shall pay such penalties, damages or costs in full within [...] ([...]) days from receipt of written notice from the Employer.
If the Contractor fails to make full payment within such period, the Employer may immediately deduct the relevant amount from payments due to the
Contractor, the retention, or enforce the performance security.
If the amounts recovered are insufficient, the Contractor shall pay the outstanding balance within [...] ([...]) days from receipt of written notice.
Any remaining balance from amounts withheld shall be returned to the Contractor.

clauses.title: Site cleanliness and restoration
clauses.text:
The Contractor shall keep the work site, including factories and facilities used by the Contractor, its employees, agents or subcontractors,
clean, safe and fit for use throughout the Contract period. Upon completion, the Contractor shall remove all equipment, materials, waste, refuse
and temporary structures and shall level and restore the ground so that the entire site is clean and ready for immediate use.

clauses.title: Waiver or reduction of penalty and extension of time
quality_notes: The Contractor must give written notice with evidence within 15 days after the cause ends, otherwise the right to relief is treated as waived (unless the Employer was at fault or knew).
clauses.text:
Where delay is caused by the Employer’s fault or default, Force Majeure, circumstances for which the Contractor is not legally responsible,
or any other circumstance prescribed by ministerial regulation issued under the law governing public procurement and supplies administration,
and the Contractor is thereby unable to complete the Works within the contractual period, the Contractor shall notify the Employer in writing
with supporting evidence to request waiver or reduction of the penalty or an extension of time within 15 days from the date on which the relevant
event ceases, or within such other period prescribed by the applicable ministerial regulation.
Failure to comply shall constitute an unconditional waiver of the Contractor’s right to request a waiver or reduction of penalty or an extension of time,
except where the delay results from the Employer’s fault or default which is clearly evidenced or was known to the Employer from the outset.
Any waiver, reduction or extension shall be subject to the Employer’s discretion.

clauses.title: Use of Thai vessels
quality_notes: Specific to Thai public procurement; probably not applicable to a private rooftop solar contract.
clauses.text:
If, in performing this Contract, the Contractor is required to order or import goods, including tools and equipment, from outside Thailand,
whether directly or through an agent or other person, and such goods are required to be transported by sea on a route served by Thai vessels
capable of providing the required carriage service as prescribed by the Minister of Transport, the Contractor shall arrange for the goods to be
carried from abroad to Thailand by a Thai vessel or a vessel having equivalent rights, unless permission has first been obtained from the Marine
Department to use another vessel or the goods fall within an exemption prescribed by the Minister of Transport.
Upon delivery of the Works, where such imported goods are included, the Contractor shall provide the Employer with the Bill of Lading or a copy
showing carriage by a Thai vessel or a vessel having equivalent rights.
Where the goods were not carried by a Thai vessel or a vessel having equivalent rights, the Contractor shall provide evidence of permission from
the Marine Department to use another vessel or evidence of payment of the special fee arising from non-use of a Thai vessel under the applicable law.
If the Contractor fails to provide such evidence but requests delivery of the Works before payment, the Employer may accept the Works and defer payment
until the Contractor has fully complied with this Clause.

clauses.title: Skilled labour standards
quality_notes: Specific to Thai public procurement; probably not applicable to a private rooftop solar contract.
clauses.text:
The Contractor agrees as a material condition of this Contract that it shall employ workers who have passed the prescribed skilled-labour standard
test administered by [...], or workers holding Vocational Certificate, Higher Vocational Certificate
or equivalent qualifications from an educational institution recognised by the Office of the Civil Service Commission for government employment,
at a rate of not less than [...] percent ([...]) in each skilled trade. There shall be at least one (1) skilled worker in each of the following trades:
23.1 [...]
23.2 [...]
[...] etc. [...]
The Contractor shall prepare a list showing the total number of workers by trade and skill level, including the names of workers who have passed
the skilled-labour standard test or hold the relevant qualifications. The list and supporting evidence shall be submitted to the inspection committee
or supervising officer before commencement of the Works and shall be available for inspection by the Employer or its officers throughout the Contract period.

clauses.title: Notes on the use of the form
quality_notes: Useful for risk checks: note (20) defects period, note (21) subcontracting penalty, note (22) penalty rate range, note (23) supervision costs.
Note (8): the English omits the Thai detail that a cheque or draft may be dated up to 3 working days before use.
clauses.text:
(1) The contract number shall be stated sequentially for each fiscal year.
(2) State the name of the government agency which is a juristic person, such as a department or state enterprise.
(3) State the name and position of the head of the relevant government agency or the person duly authorised to act on its behalf.
(4) State the Contractor’s name. (A) For a juristic person, such as a registered ordinary partnership, limited partnership or limited company.
(B) For an individual, state the individual’s name and address.
(5) This is an additional provision or condition which the government contracting agency may include or omit depending on the facts.
(6) This is an additional provision or condition which the government contracting agency may include or omit depending on the facts.
(7) State the Works to be procured.
(8) “Performance Security” means security provided by the Contractor to the government agency upon execution of the Contract to secure potential
damage arising from performance, including: (1) cash; (2) a bank cheque or draft meeting the prescribed dating requirements; (3) a domestic bank guarantee
in the prescribed form, including an electronic bank guarantee; (4) a guarantee issued by an authorised finance company or securities finance company;
or (5) Thai government bonds.
(9) The amount of performance security shall be prescribed in accordance with the applicable Ministry of Finance Regulation on Public Procurement and
Supplies Administration, B.E. 2560 (2017), Clause 168.
(10) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(11) The percentages specified in the relevant provisions may be adjusted as appropriate.
(12) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(13) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(14) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(15) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(16) Where the contracting government agency considers it necessary and appropriate, the entire monthly payment may be withheld for recovery of the advance payment.
(17) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(18) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
(19) This is an additional provision or condition which may be included or omitted depending on the facts.
